names.name: --ds-ease
names.note: Same value (the linear() path where supported). MOTION_FALLBACKS['--ds-ease'] is gone too.

names.name: --ds-spinner-sm-track
names.note: It had no effect since 1.0: delete it from the theme.

names.name: --ds-state-pulse
names.note: Read only by ds-pulse; a placeholder is a .ds-skeleton (ds-skeleton-wave).

names.name: --ds-loop-pulse
names.note: A placeholder is a .ds-skeleton, whose wave runs on --ds-loop-skeleton.

names.name: ds-pulse
names.note: One wave across the bones (ds-skeleton-wave); an animation that names ds-pulse plays nothing.

names.name: ds-indeterminate
names.note: Or .ds-loadbar: both run ds-progress-head and ds-progress-tail on --ds-loop-indeterminate.

names.name: ds-sink-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--sink, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'sink').

names.name: ds-scale-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--scale, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'scale').

names.name: ds-slide-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--slide, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'slide').

names.name: DS.motion.easeOutCubic
names.note: Remove every call and import: an import of it from js/motion.js stops the module from loading. countUp() runs on --ds-ease-value.

names.name: .ds-btn__swap
names.note: .ds-btn__faces with .ds-btn__face, .ds-btn__face--busy and .ds-btn__face--done, driven by DS.motion.busy().

names.name: data-open on .ds-combo
names.note: DS.overlay.open(list, { opener: field }) sets aria-expanded on the field, which turns the chevron.

names.name: the live region .ds-toasts[role] / .ds-toasts[aria-live]
names.note: DS.overlay.toast() announces through its own two announcers and strips role and aria-live from an old region on first use; never role="alert" on a message.

names.name: the hand recipe that moves snackbars into a side sheet
names.note: A page no longer sets --ds-toast-shift or --ds-toast-shift-y, nor closes snackbars with setTimeout: DS.overlay moves the region into an open sheet and glides the messages (both properties stay, written by DS.overlay only), and toast() times them.

names.name: the hand data-scrolled recipe
names.note: The 1.x App frame recipe: a page's own IntersectionObserver on a sentinel writes data-scrolled. Delete the observer, the sentinel and the page's own watchScrolled function, and call DS.dom.watchScrolled(view) once; DS.overlay.open() watches sheet and dialog bodies itself.

names.name: .ds-view--leaving
names.note: With it goes the manual swap recipe (settled() on the content, then enter(newContent, 'swap')).

names.name: settleLoader(startedAt, now)
names.note: A number as the second argument; the pattern finds a literal, a variable named now and the two clocks.

names.name: ds-fill-x
names.note: A mark scaled to its share squashes its round end; --ds-share clips it. Use .ds-enter--fill.

names.name: ds-fill-y
names.note: A mark scaled to its share squashes its round end; --ds-share clips it. Use .ds-enter--fill.

names.name: .ds-enter--fill-x
names.note: The mark sets --ds-share instead of its own scaleX().

names.name: .ds-enter--fill-y
names.note: The mark sets --ds-share instead of its own scaleY().

names.name: enter(el, 'fill-x')
names.note: The 'fill-x' variant of DS.motion.enter() and enterAll(); the mark sets --ds-share.

names.name: enter(el, 'fill-y')
names.note: The 'fill-y' variant of DS.motion.enter() and enterAll(); the mark sets --ds-share.

names.name: ds-edge-fade
names.note: Internal and unused: the card table wrappers fade through the scroll-edge numbers and --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: --ds-table-fade-start
names.note: Internal and unused; the length of every fade is --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: --ds-table-fade-end
names.note: Internal and unused; the length of every fade is --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: detach()
names.note: The detach method of the handle that DS.ripple.attach() returns; the pattern finds any detach() call.

names.name: .ds-btn--primary
names.note: The variant names of 3.0 are shared by every component (filled, tonal, outlined, text ...). Same look; an alias until 3.0 ships.

names.name: .ds-btn--sm
names.note: Sizes are option classes on the button or any ancestor (.ds-xs ... .ds-xl, docs/options.md). The alias keeps the fixed 2.x height (32px) and padding until 3.0 ships; .ds-sm is 32px at the default density and follows the density (24px under compact), and a small text button pads 8px instead of 12px.

names.name: --ds-btn-sm-height
names.note: Read only by the deprecated .ds-btn--sm. .ds-sm takes --ds-btn-height (the md base) less one 8px size step.

names.name: --ds-btn-sm-icon-size
names.note: Read by the deprecated .ds-btn--sm.ds-btn--icon (and the room a drawer row keeps for it). .ds-sm takes --ds-btn-icon-size less one 8px size step.

names.name: createIndicator()
names.note: The constructor of DS.indicator, named as every behaviour module names it. Same options and handle; an alias until 3.0 ships.

names.name: .ds-dialog--wide
names.note: The dialog's sizes are --sm, the default, --lg and --xl. The same width (560px).

names.name: --ds-dialog-width-wide
names.note: Read after --ds-dialog-width-lg until 3.0 ships.

names.name: data-close
names.note: Every behaviour attribute carries the data-ds- prefix. The same behaviour inside an overlay; with a value, data-ds-close also closes that overlay from outside.

names.name: the event ds-close
names.note: Every event of the system is ds:<event>. Both fire until 3.0 ships, with the same detail.reason.

names.name: .ds-check--sm
names.note: Sizes are option classes on the row or any ancestor (.ds-xs ... .ds-xl, docs/options.md). The alias keeps the fixed 2.x height (32px) and the quieter ink until 3.0 ships; .ds-sm is 32px at the default density and follows the density; the ink is the page's to choose.

names.name: --ds-check-sm-height
names.note: Read only by the deprecated .ds-check--sm. .ds-sm takes --ds-check-height (the md base) less one 8px size step.

names.name: .ds-input-group__affix
names.note: One slot per place: .ds-input-group__prefix before the input, .ds-input-group__suffix after it (a migration maps to the suffix; change a leading one to the prefix). Same look; an alias until 3.0 ships.

names.name: .ds-alert--success
names.note: Tones are option classes on the element (.ds-tone-*, docs/options.md), shared by every component that shows meaning. Same look; an alias until 3.0 ships.

names.name: .ds-spinner--sm
names.note: The text colour on a faint ring is .ds-spinner--ink; the size is the option .ds-sm (docs/options.md), so write both for the same 12px. The alias keeps its fixed 12px until 3.0 ships.

names.name: .ds-loader--sm
names.note: Sizes are option classes on the loader or any ancestor (.ds-xs ... .ds-xl, docs/options.md). .ds-sm is the same 24px.

names.name: --ds-loader-sm-size
names.note: Read only by the deprecated .ds-loader--sm. .ds-sm takes --ds-loader-size (the md base) less one 24px size step.

names.name: .ds-table--dense
names.note: Density is an option in 3.0: .ds-density-tight on the table or any ancestor gives the 40px rows (with a 36px head, which .ds-density-compact and -dense leave higher). An alias with its fixed 40px head and rows until 3.0 ships.

names.name: --ds-table-dense-row-height
names.note: Goes with .ds-table--dense: --ds-table-row-height is the base that size and density apply to.

names.name: .ds-avatar--sm
names.note: Sizes are option classes on the avatar or any ancestor (.ds-xs ... .ds-xl, docs/options.md). The alias keeps the fixed 2.x disc (24px, the caption role) until 3.0 ships; .ds-sm is 24px too, in the size's type role.

names.name: .ds-avatar--lg
names.note: Sizes are option classes on the avatar or any ancestor (.ds-xs ... .ds-xl, docs/options.md). The alias keeps the fixed 2.x disc (40px, the subtitle role) until 3.0 ships; .ds-lg is the same.

names.name: DashboardStyle
names.note: The project was renamed from Dashboard-Style to Z-Dash in 3.0: the page-wide registry is globalThis.ZDash (ZDash.versions, ZDash.runtime), the types ZDashApi and ZDashRegistry. Both globals hold the same object and the old type names stay as aliases.
